body.heading: Where in the world is Ethiopia?
paragraphs: Ethiopia is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Ethiopia is Addis Ababa.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Ethiopia is Amharic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Ethiopia is the Ethiopian birr.

body.heading: How big is Ethiopia?
paragraphs: Ethiopia covers about 1,104,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Democratic Republic of the Congo.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: About 800 years ago, workers carved entire churches down into solid rock at Lalibela — you walk down trenches to reach doors and windows cut into the stone.
The Simien Mountains are a rooftop of jagged peaks and deep cliffs where gelada monkeys graze in troops and lammergeier vultures soar overhead.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Ethiopia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Ethiopia in one breath: a country in Eastern Africa, capital Addis Ababa, where people speak Amharic and pay with the Ethiopian birr.
